trans-unit.source: Comma-separated list of page IDs that store all jobs. If tt_address records for job locations live in additional folders, list those PIDs here too - the address autocomplete search only looks at these pages.
Page with online application form for a job
Show number of jobs per job area
Appends the number of jobs to each option of the job area filter in the search form, e.g. "IT (3)". Can be overridden per content element.
Splits the list and the search results into pages. Never shown, if a content element limits the number of jobs ("Max entries to show"). Can be overridden per content element.
Number of jobs shown on one page of the list and of the search results. Further jobs are reached with the page browser.

Only jobs with salary information (salary grade or salary range) are listed, shown, searchable, rememberable and shown on the map, as demanded by the EU pay transparency directive. Disable it, as long as the directive is not yet in force in your country: then jobs without salary information are shown like any other open job. Applies to the whole site and can not be overridden per content element.

How salary amounts are displayed. "Automatic" uses the number format of the locale of the page, including the position of the currency sign, for example 1.234,56 € (de-DE), € 1.234,56 (nl-NL) or CHF 1’234.56 (de-CH). "Custom" uses the thousands separator, decimal separator and currency position below. Only the display changes, the stored salaries and the structured data for search engines stay the same.

ISO 4217 code of the currency, for example EUR, CHF or USD. The currency sign is taken from the locale of the page, for example € or CHF. Also used in the structured data for search engines. An invalid code is replaced by EUR.
Number of decimal places (0 to 4) of salary amounts. Applies to the automatic and the custom format. Amounts are rounded for the display only.

One character between groups of thousands, for example a comma, a dot, an apostrophe or a space. Leave it empty for no grouping. Only used with the number format "Custom". Digits, plus and minus signs are not allowed, and it must differ from the decimal separator. Otherwise, the automatic format is used.

One character between the whole number and the decimal places, for example a dot or a comma. Only used with the number format "Custom". Spaces, digits, plus and minus signs are not allowed, and it must differ from the thousands separator. Otherwise, the automatic format is used.
Position of the currency sign (custom format)
Whether the currency sign is put before or after the amount. Only used with the number format "Custom". The automatic format takes the position from the locale of the page.
